GAP LE PA Sync Exported Types

group GAP_LE_PA_SYNC_Exported_Types

Enums

enum T_GAP_PA_SYNC_STATE

GAP PA synchronization states.

Values:

enumerator GAP_PA_SYNC_STATE_TERMINATED

Terminated.

enumerator GAP_PA_SYNC_STATE_SYNCHRONIZING_SCAN_IDLE

Start synchronizing when extended scanning is disabled. A temporary state, haven't received the result.

enumerator GAP_PA_SYNC_STATE_SYNCHRONIZING_WAIT_SCANNING

No attempt to synchronize will take place while extended scanning is disabled.

enumerator GAP_PA_SYNC_STATE_SYNCHRONIZING

Start synchronizing when extended scanning is enabled.

enumerator GAP_PA_SYNC_STATE_SYNCHRONIZED

Synchronized.

enumerator GAP_PA_SYNC_STATE_TERMINATING

Terminate synchronization. A temporary state, haven't received the result.

enum T_GAP_PA_SYNC_PARAM_TYPE

GAP PA sync parameter types.

Values:

enumerator PA_SYNC_PARAM_PERIODIC_ADV_LIST_SIZE

Periodic advertiser list size. Read only. Size is 1 octet.

enumerator PA_SYNC_PARAM_SYNCHRONIZED_PARAM

PA synchronized parameters. Read only. Value is T_GAP_PA_SYNC_COMMON_SYNC_PARAM.

enumerator PA_SYNC_PARAM_DEV_STATE

PA synchronization device state. Read only. Value is T_GAP_PA_SYNC_DEV_STATE.

struct T_GAP_PA_SYNC_COMMON_SYNC_PARAM

Definition of GAP PA Sync Common Sync parameter.

Public Members

uint16_t sync_handle

Sync_Handle identifying the periodic advertising train.

uint8_t adv_sid

Value of the Advertising SID subfield in the ADI field of the PDU.

uint8_t adv_addr_type

Advertiser address type. T_GAP_PA_SYNC_ADV_ADDR_TYPE for reception of info.

uint8_t adv_addr[6]

Public Device Address, Random Device Address, Public Identity Address, or Random (static) Identity Address of the advertiser.

uint16_t skip

Only for sync_transfer_received_flag that is false.

uint16_t sync_timeout

Only for sync_transfer_received_flag that is false.

uint8_t sync_cte_type

Only for sync_transfer_received_flag that is false.

T_GAP_PHYS_TYPE adv_phy

Advertiser_PHY specifies the PHY used for the periodic advertising.

uint8_t adv_clock_accuracy

Advertiser_Clock_Accuracy specifies the accuracy of the periodic advertiser's clock.

  • 0x00: 500 ppm.

  • 0x01: 250 ppm.

  • 0x02: 150 ppm.

  • 0x03: 100 ppm.

  • 0x04: 75 ppm.

  • 0x05: 50 ppm.

  • 0x06: 30 ppm.

  • 0x07: 20 ppm.

uint16_t periodic_adv_interval

Periodic advertising interval.

  • Range: 0x0006 to 0xFFFF.

  • Time = N * 1.25 ms.

  • Time Range: 7.5 ms to 81.91875 s.

bool sync_transfer_received_flag

If successfully synchronized to the periodic advertising train,

  • false: Synchronization is established by le_pa_sync_create_sync.

  • true: Synchronization is received by le_past_recipient_set_default_periodic_adv_sync_transfer_params or le_past_recipient_set_periodic_adv_sync_transfer_params.

struct T_GAP_PAST_SYNC_TRANSFER_RECEIVED_PARAM

Definition of GAP PAST Sync Transfer Received parameter.

Public Members

uint8_t conn_id

Identify a connection.

uint16_t service_data

A value provided by the peer device.

struct T_GAP_PA_SYNC_CREATE_SYNC_PARAM

Definition of GAP PA Sync create sync parameter.

Public Members

uint8_t options

Synchronization State of Periodic Advertising Create Sync Options.

uint8_t sync_cte_type

Synchronization State of Periodic Advertising Create Sync CTE Type.

uint8_t adv_sid

If Periodic Advertiser List is not used (Synchronization State of Periodic Advertising Create Sync Options), Advertising SID subfield in the ADI field used to identify the Periodic Advertising.

T_GAP_PA_SYNC_ADV_ADDR_TYPE adv_addr_type

If Periodic Advertiser List is not used (Synchronization State of Periodic Advertising Create Sync Options), only PA_SYNC_ADV_ADDR_PUBLIC and PA_SYNC_ADV_ADDR_RANDOM could be used for creating sync.

uint8_t adv_addr[6]

If Periodic Advertiser List is not used (Synchronization State of Periodic Advertising Create Sync Options), Public Device Address, Random Device Address, Public Identity Address, or Random (static) Identity Address of the advertiser.

uint16_t skip

The maximum number of periodic advertising events that can be skipped after a successful receive. Range: 0x0000 to 0x01F3.

uint16_t sync_timeout

Synchronization timeout for the periodic advertising train.

  • Range: 0x000A to 0x4000.

  • Time = N*10 ms.

  • Time Range: 100 ms to 163.84 s.
